keyFeatures: Ranks 34 strength themes across 4 domains: Executing, Influencing, Relationship Building, and Strategic Thinking
Identifies your top talent themes — natural patterns of thought, feeling, and behavior
Inspired by the Gallup CliftonStrengths framework used by millions worldwide
Guidance on how to apply your top strengths to boost performance and satisfaction at work
tips: Focus on your top 5 themes first — these are your most powerful natural talents and the highest-leverage areas for development.
Strengths work best when you build complementary partnerships: find team members whose top themes balance your bottom themes rather than trying to fix your weaknesses.
